title: In-Browser File Editing & Creation, Recent Commits Diff Stepping, Hardened LSP Lifecycle & Incremental Sync, and Modular Harness Engine
summary: Introduces zero-latency in-browser file editing and item creation with dirty state protection and auto-refreshing git status, expands the git panel to browse and step through recent commit diffs, hardens language server lifecycle with deadlock-free async writer loops and incremental document synchronization, delegates harness execution to px0-ai/harness with lazy model discovery, and decomposes core engines into isolated high-performance internal packages.

categories.name: In-Browser File Editing & Creation
items: Edit files directly in the browser with Cmd/Ctrl+E, tab header button, or Command Palette, featuring line numbers, smart tab indentation, and word wrap matching code view settings
Save changes with Cmd/Ctrl+S with instant visual button success feedback and automatic git status, LSP document, search index, and syntax-highlight cache invalidation
Protect unsaved work with dirty tab indicators and confirmation prompts on close, while cleanly preserving edit state and scroll positions across tab switches
Create new files and folders from the sidebar header, tree context menu, or Command Palette (File: New File..., File: New Folder...) with automatic parent directory creation and path traversal guards
Dynamic gutter line number alignment for wrapped lines using off-screen layout measurement

categories.name: Git Panel & Recent Commits Diff Review
items: Expand recent commits in the sidebar git panel to review commit metadata, author details, relative timestamps, and per-file change stats
Open committed file diffs in pinned tabs (@hash) with a file-stepping strip (‹ / ›) to cycle through modified files in a commit without tab clutter
Fast backend commit diffstat parsing using git show numstat with first-parent filtering for merge commits
Shared commit file row rendering and 100-item pagination across both Recent Commits and Unpushed sections
Full keyboard navigation (arrow keys, Enter) and one-click short SHA copying for commit rows

categories.name: Hardened LSP Lifecycle & Incremental Sync
items: Decouple pipe I/O into dedicated writer loops and use asynchronous writes for RPC replies and cancellation requests to eliminate potential deadlocks
Serialize document open and sync operations with per-client mutexes and generation counters to discard stale out-of-order reads
Support incremental document synchronization using UTF-8 rune-safe diffs, skipping sync when content is byte-identical to previous state
Optimize UTF-16 position conversions and header parsing allocations
Cache language server binary and install tool lookup results to accelerate startup and responsiveness

categories.name: Harness Delegation & Live Stream Reliability
items: Delegate coding harness execution, preset definitions, and timeout management to the px0-ai/harness module
Lazy model discovery: query models only for the selected harness to eliminate startup process overhead
Standardize Server-Sent Events (SSE) heartbeat format to named ping events with sleep/wake detection and traffic watchdog to keep UI tabs in sync
Refresh active tabs on wake and focus even when git status signatures match

categories.name: Architecture & Developer Workflows
items: Decompose core logic into isolated internal packages: internal/ignore for gitignore matching, internal/fuzzy for two-pass bounded matching, internal/metrics for rusage metrics, and internal/table for CSV/TSV parsing
Add fast inner loop testing targets (make check, test-short, check-web) with parallel unit test execution
Eliminate status bar flickering during sidebar resize with hysteresis slack thresholds
Full-width card layout for textarea settings inputs with contextual placeholder text
Streamline markdown preview selection actions and clarify Copy Raw Markdown behavior

categories.name: Documentation
items: Add comprehensive user guides and architectural notes for in-browser file editing and new item creation
Update git integration documentation to cover recent commits browsing, diff stepping, and keyboard shortcuts
Clarify remote access security guidance to reflect writable workspace access
